'''Sadoll''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologist]] working on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was acquainted with [[Koru Tama]], aide to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Evran]], and Tama convinced [[Havoc Squad]] to retrieve a number of relics from the [[Old Paths]] region and deliver them to Sadoll at [[Kri-Ta Outpost]].
